git add jest.config.js scripts/mongoBinaryWarmup.mjs .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "fix(build): warm mongod binary once before workers

The mongo suites share one download directory; two jest workers racing a
cold download corrupt each other's archive (rename/lock ENOENT), which
reddened storeListAgreement.test.ts on CI. A globalSetup hook downloads
the binary once in the parent process, so workers only ever find it cached.

Reproduced red on a cold cache with two suites; green after (5/5, 3s).
